_why: Row 2729: the Phase-5 shell gate admits read-only `git <verb>` so the 5e verifier can measure spec-unchanged / exact-diff ACs. Each mutant loosens one refusal of the agreed denylist, or drops the admit.

mutations.name: G1: GIT NEVER ADMITTED. The pre-fix gate: the verifier is refused `git diff` and reports the AC unmeasured.
mutations.replace:
if executable == "git":  # M:CX-GIT
        return False and (

mutations.name: G2: ANY VERB. `git checkout -- <file>` reverts a production file under the gate.
G3: OPTIONS BEFORE THE VERB. The verb is looked for past global options, so `git -C /tmp diff` reads outside the root.
mutations.replace: return (len(argv) >= 2 and any(a in READ_ONLY_GIT_VERBS for a in argv[1:])

mutations.name: G4: DENIED OPTIONS IGNORED. `git diff --output=<file>` writes a file through a read verb.
mutations.find: and not any(_git_denied_option(arg) for arg in argv[2:]))

mutations.name: G5: EXACT NAMES ONLY. Git expands a unique prefix, so `--out=<file>` still writes.
mutations.find: return len(name) > 2 and any(denied.startswith(name) for denied in GIT_DENIED_OPTIONS)

mutations.name: G6: TEXTCONV DROPPED FROM THE DENYLIST. `git show --textconv` runs a configured driver.
